returns.exchangeRate: Current exchange rate between ivToken and the underlying asset, represented in 18 decimals.

deposit(uint256).details: to deposit asset in higher apy strategy.

params.amount: underlying token amount represented in 18 decimals

getVersion().details: Increase number when implementation inside source code is different that implementation deployed on Mainnet

params.asset: underlying token like DAI, USDT etc.

migrateAssetToStrategyWithMaxApr().details: Emits {Deposit} or {Withdraw} event from Stanley depending on current asset balance on Milton and Stanley. Emits {Transfer} from ERC20 asset.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate that the this implementation remains valid after an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.who: Account for which total balance is returned.

returns._0: Total balance for specific account given as a parameter, represented in 18 decimals.

upgradeTo(address).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

withdraw(uint256).details: Emits {Withdraw} event from Stanley, emits {Burn} event from ivToken, emits {Transfer} event from ERC20 asset. Input and output values are represented in 18 decimals.

returns.withdrawnAmount: final withdrawn amount of asset from Stanley, can be different than input amount due to passing time.

withdrawAll().details: Emits {Withdraw} event from Stanley, emits {Burn} event from ivToken, emits {Transfer} event from ERC20 asset. Output values are represented in 18 decimals.

returns.withdrawnAmount: final withdrawn amount of the asset.

AssetMigrated(address,address,address,ui.notice: Emmited when all Stanley's assets are migrated from old strategy to the new one. Function is available only by the Owner.

Deposit(uint256,address,address,uint256,.notice: Emmited after Milton has executed deposit function.

MiltonChanged(address,address,address).notice: Emmited when Milton address has been changed by the smart contract Owner.

StrategyChanged(address,address,address,.notice: Emmited when stratedy address has been changed by the smart contract Owner.

Withdraw(uint256,address,address,uint256.notice: Emmited when Milton executes withdraw function.

calculateExchangeRate().notice: Calculated exchange rate between ivToken and the underlying asset. Asset is specific to Stanley's intance (ex. USDC, USDT, DAI, etc.)

getAsset().notice: Gets asset / underlying token / stablecoin which is assocciated with this Stanley instance

migrateAssetToStrategyWithMaxApr().notice: Transfers all asset in current strategy to strategy with the highest APR. Function available only for the Owner.

pause().notice: Pauses current smart contract. It can be executed only by the Owner.

setMilton(address).notice: Sets Milton address. Function available only for the Owner.

totalBalance(address).notice: Gets total balance of account `who`,  transferred assets to Stanley.

unpause().notice: Unpauses current smart contract. It can be executed only by the Owner

withdraw(uint256).notice: Withdraws declared amount of asset from Stanley to Milton. Function available only for Milton.

withdrawAll().notice: Withdraws all of the asset from Stanley to Milton. Function available only for Milton.
